summary: ARMENTA OS Fase 1 verified end-to-end. Backend auth (login OK/401), and frontend full flow: unauth redirect, empty/wrong creds errors, password show/hide toggle, ES/EN toggle (login + header), successful login with 4 KPI cards, user badge 'Adrian Armenta / Administrador', session persistence on reload, quick action 'pendiente' toast, proximamente banner on module nav, logout, and post-logout route protection all pass.
passed: POST /api/auth/login with admin/armenta123 returns 200 + JWT + user(role=admin, email=adrianarmentona31@gmail.com)
Empty credentials shows 'Ingresa usuario y contraseña.'
Wrong credentials shows 'Usuario o contraseña incorrectos.' in login-error-alert
Password show/hide toggle switches input type password<->text
Language toggle on login (login-language-toggle) changes UI text
Successful admin login redirects to /control and renders dashboard-page with all 4 KPI cards (servicios-hoy, cotizaciones, por-cobrar, estado-sistema)
Session persists across page reload (stays on /control, no bounce to /login)
Quick action button action-btn-nuevo-servicio triggers 'pendiente' toast
Header logout button (header-logout-button) logs out and redirects to /login
After logout, direct navigation to /control redirects back to /login
notes: Backend smoke re-verified via curl (login returns JWT + expected user shape). All 21 review-request criteria that were re-testable at UI/API level passed. Bcrypt hash format and admin-seed idempotency were not directly verified from within this test (no Mongo access executed), but main agent had already confirmed via curl and no duplicate-admin symptoms observed.
